title: The Little Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
description: The fable of a pilot stranded in the desert and a small prince from another planet. Saint-Exupéry was born in Lyon in 1900, and a statue of him with the prince stands on a column near Place Bellecour.

title: The Death of Jean Moulin
author: Patrick Marnham
description: A British journalist’s investigation of the arrest of Jean Moulin, the Resistance leader caught at a meeting in Caluire in 1943, and of the betrayals and rivalries around it.

title: An Uncertain Hour
author: Ted Morgan
description: A history of Lyon under German occupation, of Klaus Barbie and his victims, and of the 1987 trial, by an American writer who was born in France and covered the trial.

title: Dirt
author: Bill Buford
description: An American writer moves his family to Lyon to learn French cooking, working in bakeries and kitchens. La Mère Brazier, where Paul Bocuse trained, was run by Eugénie Brazier, one of the first chefs to win three Michelin stars.
